# Momentic test maintenance: diagnose, classify, triage and repair failures

💳 **Paid service** — Momentic is a commercial AI end-to-end testing platform; this skill requires a Momentic account plus the Momentic CLI / MCP tools (check their pricing and terms). Curated by Skill Harbor — a short pointer to @momentic-ai's official test-maintenance playbook: common on-call workflows ("what happened on my branch?", "why is main red?"), failure classification against a fixed category taxonomy (application change, bug, test authorship, setup, infra, Momentic issue), AI-assisted classification and triage, de-flaking quarantined or recovered tests, retry reduction, and repair verification — with an explicit rule never to weaken a test to hide an application bug.
